Normalizes double slashes in URL paths (//page to /page)

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { WasmCrawlConfig, crawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg-wasm";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = WasmCrawlConfig.default();
  engineConfig.maxDepth = 1;
  engineConfig.respectRobotsTxt = false;
  engineConfig.ssrf.denyPrivate = false;
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawl(engine, url);
  console.log(result.pages.length);
}

void main();
```
